name: Shade sail, 12ft square HDPE
description: Knitted HDPE shade sail, 12 x 12ft square (Coolaroo class, 220 gsm), tensioned between posts or walls. Sails pull hard on their mounts in wind: anchor posts must be sized and footed for it.
source: Coolaroo Coolhaven 12ft square: 220 gsm (6.5 oz/sq yd) 100% HDPE knit (Backyard City product page)

name: Shade sail mounting kit (one corner)
description: Stainless hardware for one shade sail corner: pad eye, turnbuckle and snap hook, with screws or anchors.
source: Walmart 4-corner kit 0.88 lb (0.22 lb per corner); Yescom kit 1.65 lb net (about 0.41 lb per corner, Newegg). Estimate 0.4 lb over a 10 x 2 x 1in box

name: Built-in gas grill head
description: Built-in stainless gas grill head, 32in 4-burner (Blaze Premium LTE class), dropped into a masonry or steel-frame island. For the materials list only, not simulated; the gas line is usually run by a licensed plumber or gas fitter.
source: Blaze Premium LTE+ 32in propane: 114 lb, 32.5 W x 25.75 D x 21.25 H in (BBQ Galore); effective density 114 lb over that box

name: Outdoor stainless sink
description: Stainless steel drop-in outdoor sink (about 15in, 304 or 316 stainless) for an outdoor kitchen island, with faucet holes. Needs a supply line and a drain; winterize where it freezes.
source: Delta Heat 15in drop-in outdoor sink: 12 lb, 15 W x 20 D x 5.38 H in, 304 stainless (Blazing Embers product page); effective density 12 lb over that box

name: Concrete countertop
description: Cast concrete countertop, typically 1-1/2 to 2in thick, sealed. Usually fabricated and installed by a specialist at about $50-$150 per sq ft; the price here is materials only.
source: Remodeling Calculator: 1.5in concrete countertop about 18.75 psf (150 pcf)

name: Pool equipment pad (3 x 4ft)
description: Plastic/rubber equipment pad, 36 x 48 x 3in, set on compacted gravel under a pool pump, filter or heater.
source: Diversitech The Black Pad ACP36483, 36 x 48 x 3in: 38 lb (Pool Warehouse; Ferguson lists 125 lb for the same part, conflicting); 38 lb over that box

name: Precast concrete pool coping
description: Precast concrete bullnose pool coping, 12 x 24in pieces about 2in thick, mortared on the bond beam.
source: DFW 12x24 straight bullnose coping: 50 lb (white, tan), 48 lb (gray), 2.125in thick (DFW / Pool360); 50 lb over 12 x 24 x 2.125in

name: Travertine pool coping
description: Tumbled travertine bullnose pool coping, 12 x 24in, about 1-1/4in (3cm) thick, mortared on the bond beam. Seal it; travertine stays cooler underfoot than concrete.
source: Floor & Decor Casa Antica Country Classic tumbled travertine bullnose 3cm coping (100934512): 31.17 lb per 12 x 24in piece, 30.16mm thick; 31.17 lb over 12 x 24 x 1.19in
